brief:
Israeli occupation forces escalated military operations across the northern West Bank on Monday evening, converting a Palestinian home into a military post in the Tubas and Tulkarem governorates, IMEMC News reported. Forces invaded several towns and a refugee camp during the operations.

An Israeli military incursion resulted in the abduction of a Palestinian father and son in Tubas. The specific locations targeted and the identities of those detained were not immediately detailed in initial reports of the escalation.

title: Israeli forces escalate operations in northern West Bank towns
